close_reason: Replaced ClosureHandler::new's Box<BackendCallFn<B,C>> parameter with a generic F: Fn(...) + Send + Sync + 'static bound. Callers can drop Box::new wrapping; the closure is boxed once internally at construction. Backward-compat verified: existing Box::new(...) callers compile unchanged because Box<dyn Fn(...)+ Send+Sync+'static> itself implements Fn(...) via blanket impl. Propagated the boilerplate drop to all 10 reg! macro sites across the 8 extension-server siblings (3 in mail-server, 1 each in chat/calendars/tasks/contacts/filenode/sharing/metadata) per the canonical-template rule. Updated the doc example in jmap-server and the two unit tests. Workspace clippy + 142 test suites green. Commit b0d97b4.
title: ClosureHandler::new requires Box<BackendCallFn<B, C>> — forces every caller to write Box::new(...)
